sections.h2: SEO for Free Zone and Mainland Companies
sections.intro: The UAE has two kinds of businesses, and SEO works slightly differently for each.

items.title: SEO for Free Zone Companies in Dubai
items.text: SEO for free zone companies in Dubai, such as DMCC, Dubai Silicon Oasis or Dubai Internet City, usually targets international and B2B buyers. These companies need strong English content, case studies and links from industry sites outside the UAE as well. We also list your company in the right free zone and chamber directories.

items.title: Mainland and Data Privacy
items.html: Mainland businesses usually target local customers, so Google Maps and Arabic keywords matter more. Every UAE website that tracks visitors must also respect the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021. DIFC and ADGM companies follow their own data protection rules. We set up consent-friendly tracking in Google Analytics 4 so your reports are accurate and compliant. Read the official overview on the UAE Government portal.
